llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The artifact confirms a broad any-to-any capability claim. That breadth matches the advertised CellCog role, but users should invoke it deliberately for CellCog/off-platform work.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact confirms SHOW_FILE content is uploaded to CellCog and includes a warning not to attach secrets. Broader data-minimization guidance is appropriate, but the behavior is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use CellCog as a third-party AI service. Anything placed in SHOW_FILE tags is uploaded, and generated files may be written locally, so review paths carefully and do not include secrets, credentials, private customer data, or regulated information unless you have approval to share it with CellCog.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed CellCog integration that sends prompts and user-tagged files to a remote AI service and downloads results, with no hidden executable payload in the artifact.
